**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 (¶¶ p0082–p0084) is the document's only audit right running against us, and it lands squarely on the playbook's *preferred* position:

| Playbook (preferred) | Section 22 |
|---|---|
| ≤ once per 12 months | "no more than once in any twelve-month period" ✓ |
| 30 days' written notice | "at least thirty days' prior written notice" ✓ |
| Business hours | "during normal business hours" + no unreasonable disruption ✓ |
| Independent auditor under confidentiality | "off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality" ✓ |
| Vendor cost unless underpayment > 5% | "Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent" ✓ |
| No direct system access | "Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly, Customer Data unrelated to usage, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information" ✓ |

Section 22.3 adds further customer-side protection (findings are Customer Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and finality on payment of a shortfall). I also confirmed that § 23 "Records and Customer Assurance" carries a heading only, and that no inspection, verification, or monitoring rights against us appear elsewhere in the agreement.
